DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome

Nephrotic syndrome is a collection of symptoms that result from damage to the filters in your kidneys. This damage causes large amounts of protein to leak into your urine, leading to low levels of protein in your blood, which can cause swelling, especially in your legs. It can also affect your cholesterol levels and increase your risk of blood clots. We'll need to manage this with medication and lifestyle changes, and I'll refer you to a nephrologist for further care.
